about: Jacobs & Comerota is a personal injury firm with a single office in Philadelphia.
The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free; its intake line is open around the clock.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours and photo count come from the Places API. The owner's own description, the services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way. The API does expose Google's editorial summary, which is a different thing: Google writes those about notable places and has written one for no firm in this directory.

json_ld_descriptions: Jacobs & Comerota provides legal services for accidents and other injuries in Philadelphia, PA. If you ask around, you'll find that we're the injury lawyer Philadelphia, PA residents know and recommend. That's why we're happy to share all the great results we've had throughout the years. There's no reason to be stuck with exorbitant medical bills after an accident. Our law firm is ready to help you with your personal injury claim. Whether you're in need of a truck accident lawyer, a car accident lawyer, or a dog bite lawyer, we want to hear from you. Reach out to us today and learn what makes us the first choice for a personal injury lawyer in Philadelphia, PA.
